title: TSA Vendor Invoice Routing After Legal Entity Rationalization
scenario_text:
Cascade Financial Group completed its acquisition of Piedmont Savings & Trust in March 2025. Legal entity rationalization collapsed Piedmont into Cascade's entity structure on Day 100 (Jul 1, 2025), but a Transition Services Agreement keeps certain vendor relationships active under the old Piedmont entity name through December 2026. A vendor invoice has arrived that doesn't fit neatly into either category.

**Outlook — Accounts Payable Inbox (Jun 25, 2026)**
From: billing@cabornetech.com
To: ap@piedmontsavings.com (forwarded to ap@cascadefinancial.com per mail redirect)
Subject: Invoice #CT-2026-0891 — Annual License Renewal
'Please find attached invoice for annual license renewal of CaborneTech DataVault platform. Amount: $187,500. Due: Jul 25, 2026. Bill-to: Piedmont Savings & Trust, 440 Market St, Greensboro NC.'
Attachment: CT-2026-0891.pdf (last modified: Jun 20, 2026)

**SharePoint — /integration/tsa/schedule-a-services.xlsx (Last modified: Mar 15, 2025)**
Row 18: Vendor: CaborneTech | Service: Data archival platform | TSA Category: IT Infrastructure | TSA End: Dec 31, 2026 | Monthly Cost: $15,625 | Responsible Party: Cascade (paying) | Notes: 'License was 3-year term, renews annually. Cascade assumes cost from Day 1.'

**Dynamics 365 — Vendor Record**
Vendor: CaborneTech Solutions Inc. | Vendor #: V-40221 | Status: Active | Payment Terms: Net 30 | Default GL: 6200-IT-INFRA | Entity: CASCADE FINANCIAL GROUP
Note (added Apr 2025): 'Migrated from Piedmont vendor master. Original vendor # PST-1887.'

**Microsoft Teams — #ap-operations (Jun 25, 2026, 2:20 PM)**
@rachel.dunn: Got a CaborneTech invoice addressed to Piedmont. $187,500. Their schedule shows monthly at $15,625 — that's only $187,500 annually so the math checks out but this is an annual lump sum, not monthly. Do we pay it?
@kevin.cho: Is it on the TSA schedule?
@rachel.dunn: Yes but the schedule says monthly cost $15,625. This invoice is for the whole year upfront.
@kevin.cho: Might be the renewal structure changed. Check with procurement if the contract terms allow annual billing.
@rachel.dunn: Also the amount matches exactly ($15,625 x 12) so it's not like they're overcharging.
@kevin.cho: :thinking_face: but wait — didn't we renegotiate CaborneTech during the synergy review? I swear I saw something about that.
[No further replies]

**Outlook — From: j.park@cascadefinancial.com (May 8, 2026)**
To: procurement-integration@cascadefinancial.com
CC: cfo-office@cascadefinancial.com
Subject: CaborneTech Synergy Outcome
'Following the vendor rationalization review, we've confirmed CaborneTech DataVault will be decommissioned when we complete migration to Cascade's existing Iron Mountain archival service (target: Q3 2026). CaborneTech has been notified of non-renewal. Their current term expires June 30, 2026. We should NOT be receiving any renewal invoices. If one arrives, reject it — the contract is not being extended.'

**FIS Horizon — System Log (Jun 20, 2026)**
Data export job 'PiedmontArchive-Daily' status: ACTIVE | Target: CaborneTech DataVault endpoint | Records exported today: 14,221 | No errors.
question: What should Accounts Payable do with invoice #CT-2026-0891 from CaborneTech?

contributor.name: Karen Johanssen
contributor.title: M&A Integration Program Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Post-merger integration planning, system consolidation, entity rationalization, policy harmonization

choices: Pay the invoice but flag for review — the FIS Horizon system is still actively sending data to CaborneTech, meaning the service is operationally needed regardless of the non-renewal decision
Pay the invoice — it's on the TSA schedule, the amount matches the annual equivalent of the monthly rate, and the TSA runs through December 2026
Escalate to legal — the TSA schedule says the service runs through December 2026, but procurement says non-renewal; these conflict and AP cannot unilaterally decide
Reject the invoice — procurement confirmed non-renewal and contract expiry on June 30, 2026; the invoice is for a renewal period Cascade has explicitly declined
